description: Design for future 008J Real Runtime Dispatch Implementation. Spec only; no runtime, no dispatch, no Agent subprocess, no IPC, no gateway, no ingest, no default system prompt mutation, no real handoff/audit write. Identifies exact dispatch surface, allowed files, forbidden files, feature flag gate, target agent gate, trigger gate, rollback plan, PR gate, stop conditions.

discovered_surfaces.role: Surface B dry-run helper; produces final_task_prompt string with preamble prepended; no I/O
discovered_surfaces.rationale: 008J may consume this helper output; do NOT mutate it; do NOT add side effects

discovered_surfaces.path: NEW file (e.g. src/main/task-dispatch-prompt-builder.ts) — gated by KNOWLEDGE_CONTRACT_INJECTION_ENABLED
discovered_surfaces.role: Future 008J entry point: read flag, call 008F helper, pass composed prompt to existing task prompt builder chain
discovered_surfaces.rationale: 008I recommends creating ONE new pure function file; this file MUST stay pure (no spawn / no IPC / no fetch); the existing task prompt builder chain consumes its return value

discovered_surfaces.path: does not exist as a single dedicated file in src/main; future 008J must identify the actual prompt builder in the dispatch path before wiring
discovered_surfaces.role: Future target: existing chain that builds the final task prompt sent to a target agent
discovered_surfaces.rationale: 008J must not mutate the existing chain in place; instead, the new pure file emits a string that the existing chain consumes (or 008J must wait for chain identification in a separate ADR)

discovered_surfaces.path: no agent default system prompt mutation anywhere in src/main today
discovered_surfaces.role: Future Phase 2 Surface C: embed contract snippet as global default system prompt fragment
discovered_surfaces.rationale: 008A § 7 + 008H NO-GO: high blast radius, not slice-reversible, touches locked files (CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md / Hermes default)

discovered_surfaces.path: no real handoff/audit writer today; 008E readiness review marked frozen; renderer-bound preload IPC is separate user-invoked path
discovered_surfaces.role: Future 008 (留 008+ 显式批): real IPC adapter for handoff/audit live flush
discovered_surfaces.rationale: 008I NOT-GO for live adapter; 008J must NOT touch IPC / gateway / serve / run / agent / delegate / playbook / cron; live flush is L6 separate ADR

discovered_surfaces.path: no Agent subprocess spawn in src/main today; HCC Auto Executor not approved, not started
discovered_surfaces.role: Future real dispatch: spawn Agent subprocess
discovered_surfaces.rationale: 008I NOT-GO: spawn / child_process / runPlaybook / sendMessage all forbidden; 008J must stay pure (no subprocess)

recommended_surface.name: 008J Real Runtime Dispatch — NEW pure task-dispatch-prompt-builder

rationale: Surface B dry-run is mature and locked (008F + 008G + 008H); the missing link is real prompt-builder wiring

Touching IPC / gateway / live adapter is out of scope and not the recommended entry point

008E / 008H NOT-GO; live adapter is L6留 separate ADR + 显式批; not part of 008J scope
008H NOT-GO; spawn / child_process / runPlaybook / sendMessage all forbidden; HCC Auto Executor not approved

discovers need for real audit log writer to ~/.hermes/audit

base task prompt is overwritten (must be preserved verbatim, only preamble prepended)
runtime flags can be forged to true (008F assertKnowledgeSurfaceBNoRuntime must reject)
forbidden copy appears in simulated preamble (no 已保存 / 写入成功 / saved successfully / will be written after confirm; deceptive-phrase detector must reject)
knowledgeIngest( / knowledgeSearch( / fetch( appears as call expression in entry point output
executable_steps / verificationCommands / next_actions call-form action appears in any payload
Agent subprocess spawn attempted (no spawn / child_process / runPlaybook)
pr_gate: forbidden token scan: 0 真 runtime call 表达式 in entry point + test + fixture + doc
assertKnowledgeSurfaceBNoRuntime passes for normal composed prompt
4 literal false runtime flags preserved (runtime_flush_allowed / runtime_dispatch_allowed / real_handoff_write_allowed / live_adapter_allowed)
